subject: Re: Demo: Redwood inference for FinTechCo - scheduling + prep
messages:
From: Alicia Torres <alicia@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Demo: Redwood inference for FinTechCo - Tue Jul 20 10:00 PT

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick reply on the call last week - excited to see Redwood in action. Would Tuesday, July 20 at 10:00 AM PT work for a 45-minute product demo focused on NLP inference and cost/latency optimizations?

Proposed agenda (tentative):
- 10 min: intros + goals
- 20 min: demo with our sample prompts and traces
- 10 min: Q&A and next steps

We can share a small slice of our data for the demo - I can provision a sample schema and an S3 prefix with sample traces. Would you and your team need any special access or prep on our side?

Thanks,
Alicia Torres
Head of Engineering
FinTechCo

--
Attachment: FinTechCo_sample_schema.csv (will attach once we confirm scheduling)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia@fintechco.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@fintechco.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood inference for FinTechCo - Tue Jul 20 10:00 PT

Hi Alicia - thanks, and appreciate you lining this up.

Quick heads up: I'll be traveling on the 20th and won't be able to lead the demo that day. Would you be open to moving to Thu Jul 22 (10 AM PT) or Fri Jul 23 (11 AM PT)? Friday at 11 would give us a bit more runway to prepare tech artifacts on our side.

On the prep items: to make the demo most relevant we'd like:
- A small prompt set (5-10 representative prompts) and expected outputs or success criteria
- A sample of your workload traces or token distribution (tips on seq lengths, rate)
- Read-only access to a sandbox S3 prefix or a zipped sample (we'll only use it to craft the demo; security review completed)

I'm attaching a short agenda for our side (redwood-demo-agenda.pdf) and a prep checklist. If you can share the sample schema and a link to the sample data, we'll start creating a tailored prompt set and a short eval to run during the demo.

If Friday 7/23 at 11 AM PT works we'll confirm and I'll loop in Dev (cc'd) and Vivek to prep the prompt/workload checklist and run a quick dry run.

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

--
Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf
Attachment: fintech-demo-prep-checklist.md

From: Alicia Torres <alicia@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T14:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood inference for FinTechCo - scheduling + prep

Hi Marissa,

Friday 7/23 at 11 AM PT works for us - thanks for the heads up. I'll have Samir provision a read-only S3 prefix and attach the sample schema now.

We'll deliver:
- FinTechCo_sample_schema.csv (attached)
- A zipped folder with ~20 sample traces (anonymized) via secure link - we'll send a private link in the next email
- Notes on success criteria (what counts as acceptable latency/throughput for your use case)

For access, we plan to create a short-lived IAM user with read-only access to s3://fintechco-sandbox/sample-data and will share credentials through our secure vault. Expect the provisioning email from Samir shortly.

See you on 7/23 - appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Alicia

--
Attachment: FinTechCo_sample_schema.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Action items - FinTechCo demo (Fri 7/23 11 AM PT)

Team - confirmed: demo moved to Fri 7/23 at 11 AM PT. Alicia will provision a read-only S3 prefix and share the schema. High-level asks: please see bullets and take ownership.

Dev - can you own prompt set creation and a dry-run eval?
- Create 6 prompts that reflect FinTechCo intents (payment routing, fraud detection edge cases, customer support summaries)
- Prepare a short script to run the prompts against the sample traces and capture latency/median p50/p95

Vivek - can you validate runbook/access and pick a quantization profile to suggest?
- Confirm we can load the sample traces into a dev instance and that no PII remains
- Recommend batch size / KV cache settings and a quantized variant to demo cost tradeoffs

Attachments: fintech-demo-prep-checklist.md, redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

Alicia - once Samir shares the s3 link/creds, we'll start. We'll also do a 30-min dry run on Thu 7/22 if that works for you (earlier than the demo).

Thanks -
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action items - FinTechCo demo (Fri 7/23 11 AM PT)

Thanks Marissa - I'll take the prompt sets and the eval script.

Following up on Alicia's note: I've requested the short-lived read-only IAM user from Samir and asked that the S3 prefix include a top-level README describing the trace formats. Once I have the creds I'll pull the samples and run the prompts locally; I'll post results to the Drive folder and flag any data/format issues.

I'll also schedule a 30-min dry run with Vivek for Thu 7/22 at 9 AM PT - will share a calendar invite.

Dev
